briefdescription.para: An XVM Structure that represents a multi-method, which is a group of methods that share a name.

detaileddescription.para: The multi-method does not have a corresponding development-time analogy; a developer does NOT declare or define a multi-method. Instead, it is a compile-time construction, used to collect together methods that share a name into a group, within which they are identified by a more exacting set of attributes, namely their accessibility and their parameter/return types.
